messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: VelaCorp (VPC) high 5xx rate detected for tenant=vela on model variant v2-bert-int8. Auto-safevariant exists but did not reconcile. Alert: https://console.redwood/incidents/4987654321
Jae (eng-sre): I'm oncall — paging eng-runtime and eng-ml. @Rina @Anu
Rina (eng-ml): Acknowledged. Which variant is the tenant currently pinned to? I can see an override for v2-bert-int8.
Liam (support): CSM looped in, customer bridge up. They report spike started ~16:42 UTC.
Anu (eng-runtime): Observability: KV cache eviction rate spiked x4, GPU mem alloc failures on nodes pool-vela-eu1. Likely memory pressure causing request failures.
Jae (eng-sre): Correlating — 5xxs start at 16:42, matches eviction storm. Initiating emergency tenant pin to safevariant to stop customer impact.
Jae (eng-sre): Running: `/admin tenant override set --tenant vela --model v2-bert-fp16 --reason "emergency fallback - kv-evictions"`
deploy-bot: executed command by Jae; tenant override created -> pinned model=v2-bert-fp16, ttl=30m
Maya (CS): On call with customer — they already see errors dropping. p95 latency up ~120ms but tolerable for them.
Omar (security): Quick check: no auth anomalies or request leakage observed in control plane. Data plane continues to respect tenant isolation.
Rina (eng-ml): Good. Post-mitigation action: we need stronger safevariant gating. Proposal: auto-fallback when KV evictions > 50/min OR 5xx rate > 5% for 2m.
Liam (support): Updating customer-facing note: "Mitigated by temporary model pin to v2-bert-fp16. Engineering investigating GPU memory pressure that caused KV cache evictions and 5xxs."
Jae (eng-sre): Kicking off request capture for triage: `/admin capture-requests --tenant vela --duration 15m --out s3://incidents/vela/4987654321/requests.json`
deploy-bot: capture started; artifacts available at s3://incidents/vela/4987654321/
Anu (eng-runtime): Dumping node logs and NVML metrics to the incident bucket as well.
Rina (eng-ml): Plan for safe re-enable: run canary with int8 quantization but with batch_size=1 and +20% KV cache headroom to validate stability.
Alex (sales): Thanks — customer appreciates the fast action. Please share RCA + configuration recommendations once available.
Maya (CS): Customer asked ETA for rollback of the pin. We estimate 2-4 hours to validate canary and confirm stability.
Jae (eng-sre): After ~12m pinned, error rate down to baseline. Keeping pin until canary completes and a root-cause action is applied. Filing follow-up ticket INF-5234.
Liam (support): Noted. Will update the customer timeline and close the bridge once rollback scheduled.
Rina (eng-ml): Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: int8 execution path + bursty large requests caused allocator fragmentation and KV cache pressure, leading to evictions and backend failures under memory-constrained kernel state.
Jae (eng-sre): Follow-up actions: 1) schedule node drain+restart for pool-vela-eu1 to reclaim kernel memory 2) run canary with modified int8 config 3) tighten safevariant thresholds & alerts 4) increase KV cache headroom alerting
Maya (CS): Customer is okay with the plan; asked for a written postmortem and config changes as deliverables.
incident-bot: Pager resolved by Jae (eng-sre). Incident closed. :white_check_mark:
